strings.Wizard.Title: Translation Setup Wizard
strings.Wizard.Body: Choose a mode, fill only required fields, run check, then apply.
strings.Wizard.Step1Hint: Start with v2 if you need the easiest cloud setup. Use v3 for service-account based setup.
strings.Wizard.Step2Hint: Use buttons below to open the exact Google Cloud pages you need. Then fill only required fields.
strings.Wizard.Step2InstructionV2:
Quick setup for v2:
1. On this form click "Open API page" and enable Cloud Translation API for your project.
2. On this form click "Open API keys page" and create an API key (Create credentials -> API key).
3. Copy the key and paste it into the API key field below.
4. Go to Step 3 and click "Check connection".
strings.Wizard.Step2InstructionV3:
Quick setup for v3:
1. On this form click "Open API page" and enable Cloud Translation API for your project.
2. On this form click "Open Service Accounts page" and create a service account.
3. Open that service account -> Permissions -> Manage access.
4. In role selection choose "Cloud Translation API User" (or an equivalent role with translation access), then save.
5. In that service account create a JSON key (Keys -> Add key -> Create new key -> JSON) and download it.
6. Back in this wizard click "Browse..." and select the JSON file.
7. Verify Project ID is correct. You can copy it in Google Cloud from Project info (Project ID) or from the project selector at the top.
8. Go to Step 3 and click "Check connection".
strings.Wizard.Step2InstructionWeb: Web mode does not require Google Cloud setup. You can proceed to verification.
strings.Wizard.Step3Hint: Run connection check. For cloud modes, apply is enabled only after successful check.
